rule: Object east/north are historical-geographic registration. Object up is sampled only from the canonical terrain mesh and must carry sampling provenance.
gates: No object receives a fabricated elevation before a real terrain payload exists.
Terrain sampling never changes object east/north.
Sampling distance is recorded for audit and later interpolation upgrades.
Withheld geographic objects remain withheld and receive no elevation.
All eras share the same terrain elevation authority.
nextUpgrade: Replace nearest-vertex sampling with triangle/bilinear interpolation after the first real DEM mesh is ingested; preserve the original sample provenance.
